# Hire Excellence

> Hire Excellence is a free, AI-first hiring network and professional social network. An AI runs a five-minute spoken first-round interview for every applicant, scores each answer against the job description, and gives recruiters a ranked shortlist with the reasoning behind every score, so recruiters meet the right people and candidates hear back fast.

Website: https://hire-excellence.n1m35h.in
Tagline: Hire on signal, not on resumes.
Pricing: Free. Creating a profile, posting positions and applying to jobs cost nothing.
Source code: https://github.com/GitNimay/hire-excellence

## What it does

- **Structured voice interviews**: a five-minute spoken first round, conducted by an LLM voice agent. Candidates take it whenever they like before the position's closing date.
- **Timed assessments**: recruiters can swap the voice interview for a timed multiple-choice test.
- **Evaluation against the role**: each answer is assessed against the job description, producing a score, a fit rating, and written strengths and concerns.
- **Profiles from resumes**: uploading a resume fills in the profile automatically; the profile can be exported as an ATS-friendly PDF resume.
- **Unified applicant pipeline**: recruiters track every application from submission to shortlist, with interview results attached.
- **Verified company pages**: each company page is tied to a single domain and verified through a work email on that domain. Only verified pages can post jobs.
- **Professional network**: posts, replies, reactions, follows, profiles and a feed, similar to LinkedIn.

## How hiring works

1. Identify the role.
2. Verify your organization with a work email.
3. Publish the position.
4. Receive applications.
5. The AI conducts first-round interviews.
6. Review the ranked shortlist.

## Who it is for

- **Candidates**: be assessed on your experience rather than resume keywords; interview on your own schedule; build a complete profile in one step.
- **Employers and recruiters**: replace preliminary phone screens with a ranked shortlist; no interview scheduling for the first round.

## FAQ

- **Is it free?** Yes. Profiles, job posts and applications are free.
- **How long is the interview?** About five minutes, any time before the closing date.
- **Who can see my interview?** Only the recruiters responsible for the position you applied to.
- **Is the voice interview mandatory?** No. Where the recruiter allows it, you can take a timed multiple-choice assessment instead.
- **How are companies verified?** Each company page is bound to one domain and verified through a work email address on that domain.
